externalResources.title: Official Wiki taxonomy
externalResources.titleZh: 官方 Wiki 分类骨架
externalResources.description: Use the official Wiki to browse the game's entity families: ranching, farming, buildings, animals, quests, shops, locations and items. Older numbers still need current-build verification.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 用官方 Wiki 浏览游戏的实体分类：牧场、种田、建筑、动物、任务、商店、地点和物品。旧版数字仍需在当前版本重新核对。

externalResources.title: Official Steam news
externalResources.description: Check this feed for patch notes and developer announcements before trusting a number or troubleshooting step.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 在确认数字或排查步骤前，先到这里查看补丁说明和开发者公告。

externalResources.title: Crop seed prices and yield tests
externalResources.titleZh: 作物种子价格与产量实测
externalResources.description: A Steam guide points toward seed-cost and yield comparisons. Treat it as a lead until current-build records or a second independent test agree.
externalResources.descriptionZh: Steam 指南提供了种子成本与产量比较方向。在当前版本记录或第二个独立测试确认前，它仍只是线索。

externalResources.title: Animal husbandry and production
externalResources.description: The Steam guide index includes an animal husbandry guide. Use it as a checklist for what to test, not as a replacement for current evidence.
externalResources.descriptionZh: Steam 指南索引里有动物养殖指南。它适合作为复测清单，不替代当前版本证据。

externalResources.title: Official press kit
externalResources.description: The developer's page lists logos, splash art and GIFs. It does not display a commercial reuse licence, so this is an asset reference, not a download permission.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 开发者页面列出 Logo、宣传图和 GIF，但没有显示商业复用许可。因此这里只作为素材参考，不代表可以直接下载转载。

sources.title: Greenhouse and winter: what is confirmed
sources.titleZh: 温室与冬季：目前已确认的规则
sources.summary: A moderator says the greenhouse does not need heating. Snow inside is a visual issue under repair; seeds remain seasonal, but a greenhouse can grow them outside their purchase season. No winter crops are currently available.
sources.summaryZh: 官方版主说明温室不需要供暖；室内积雪是待修复的画面问题，不影响作物。种子仍按季节购买，但温室可以跨季种植；目前没有冬季作物。
sources.why: This is a usable answer, but it does not prove the current greenhouse unlock route, cost or sprinkler setup.
sources.whyZh: 这能直接帮助玩家判断温室怎么用，但不能证明当前版本的解锁路线、材料价格或洒水器接法。
sources.risk: The reply does not confirm the unlock route, cost or sprinkler setup; do not fill those gaps from older guides.
sources.riskZh: 这条答复没有确认解锁路线、材料价格或洒水器接法；不要用旧攻略替它补全这些空白。

sources.title: How to remove an empty crop square
sources.summary: There is no tool to remove a tilled square manually. Leave it empty, unseeded and unwatered; after several dry days it can disappear on its own. Rain slows that recovery.
sources.summaryZh: 当前没有手动移除农田格的工具。让它保持空白、不播种、不浇水，经过几个干燥日后会自然消失；下雨会拖慢这个过程。
sources.why: The exact number of days is still not official, so the guide keeps the player estimate separate from the supported action.
sources.whyZh: 官方没有给出精确天数，所以页面只采用可执行的处理方式，不把玩家估计的天数写成定论。
sources.risk: The recovery time is not a confirmed day count, and rain or a patch may change the observed timing.
sources.riskZh: 恢复时间没有确认的具体天数；下雨或后续补丁可能改变玩家观察到的时长。

sources.title: Why eggs are marked Infertile
sources.summary: The official troubleshooting answer points to breeding age and complete needs or satisfaction as prerequisites. A player also reported a linked-count recovery after moving a rooster out and back, but that workaround remains a single report.
sources.summaryZh: 官方排查答复指出，繁殖需要达到繁殖年龄，并满足全部需求与满意度。玩家还报告过迁出再迁回公鸡后恢复受精，但这个 workaround 仍只是单人报告。
sources.why: The page separates the official prerequisites from the unverified relocation workaround instead of presenting one player fix as a universal rule.
sources.whyZh: 页面把官方前置条件和单人报告的迁舍 workaround 分开，避免把一个玩家的修复方法说成通用机制。
sources.risk: The relocation workaround is a single player report and may not reproduce on every coop or build.
sources.riskZh: 迁舍 workaround 只是单人报告，未必能在每个鸡舍或版本复现。
sources.sourceLabelZh: 官方前置条件 + 玩家线索

sources.title: Animal seller shop is locked
sources.summary: The official answer says a purple-heart relationship can trigger a shop embargo, and only the first gift of the day changes the relationship. A player reported recovering access with plant gifts; the exact favourite list still needs separate testing.
sources.summaryZh: 官方答复说明，紫心关系可能触发商店封锁，而且每天只有第一份礼物影响关系。玩家报告用植物类礼物恢复入口，但具体喜好表仍需分别验证。
sources.why: This turns a vague NPC problem into a clear first check without inventing a universal best gift.
sources.whyZh: 它把“商店打不开”变成了明确的第一步排查，同时没有凭空编造通用的最佳礼物。
sources.risk: The plant-gift recovery is a player report, not a universal favourite list or guaranteed fix.
sources.riskZh: 植物礼物恢复商店只是玩家报告，不是通用喜好表，也不是保证有效的修复。
sources.sourceLabelZh: 官方机制 + 玩家恢复报告

sources.title: NPC relationship recovery is still an open lead
sources.titleZh: NPC 关系恢复仍是待验证线索
sources.summary: A current player question asks how to recover an NPC relationship after gifts stopped helping and the NPC stopped talking. The official shop-embargo reply is useful context, but the current question has no universal gift list or confirmed recovery route.
sources.summaryZh: 当前玩家问题在追问：送礼不再生效、NPC 不愿对话后，关系该怎么恢复。官方关于商店封锁的答复可以提供背景，但这条新问题没有通用礼物表，也没有确认的恢复路线。
sources.why: It points to a real player pain point without turning one player's gift experiment into a rule. A build, NPC name and before/after relationship screenshot would make it testable.
sources.whyZh: 它指向真实的玩家痛点，但没有把一个玩家的送礼尝试写成规则。补充版本、NPC 名称和关系变化前后截图后，才适合复测。
sources.risk: Do not assume one plant gift, favourite list or number of days works for every NPC. The current post has no official resolution.
sources.riskZh: 不要假设某种植物礼物、喜好表或天数对所有 NPC 都有效；当前帖子还没有官方解决方案。
sources.sourceLabelZh: 当前玩家问题 + 官方背景

sources.title: A current charcoal lead, but no public steps yet
sources.titleZh: 当前有木炭线索，但公开步骤还不完整
sources.summary: A current Steam community item says a player figured out how to make charcoal, but its public preview does not show the method. An older Alpha discussion described burning wood or logs, so it is useful as a research lead only.
sources.summaryZh: 当前 Steam 社区里有玩家表示自己找到了制作木炭的方法，但公开预览没有给出步骤。更早的 Alpha 讨论提到燃烧木材或原木，因此目前只能把它当作研究线索。
sources.why: Players looking for charcoal now have a place to compare new reports and submit a screenshot or clip. The old thread also tells us what must be re-tested, without pretending its recipe is current.
sources.whyZh: 正在找木炭的玩家有了集中比对新报告、提交截图或视频的位置。旧帖可以提示复测方向，但不能把旧配方当成当前答案。
sources.risk: The Alpha method, yield and fire behaviour may be obsolete. Do not treat burning logs, an 8-charcoal yield or fire-spread warnings as current instructions.
sources.riskZh: Alpha 版本的方法、产量和火焰行为可能已经过时。不要把燃烧原木、8 个木炭产量或火势蔓延提醒当成当前操作说明。
sources.sourceLabel: Current player lead + Historical Alpha thread
sources.sourceLabelZh: 当前玩家线索 + 历史 Alpha 帖

sources.title: Can extra roosters be sold?
sources.summary: A current player is asking whether Early Access has a way to sell extra roosters or chickens after hatching too many males. The site's animal record already carries an official answer that live-animal sales are not implemented, but the direct source URL is not retained in this card; the new question is a prompt to recheck for a later change.
sources.summaryZh: 当前玩家在询问：孵出太多公鸡后，Early Access 是否有出售多余公鸡或鸡的办法。本站动物记录已有官方答复称活体出售尚未实装，但这张卡没有保留原帖直链；新问题适合用来监测后续版本是否变化。
sources.why: It connects a live player question to the existing chicken selling answer instead of leaving the player at an isolated discussion index.
sources.whyZh: 它把当前玩家问题接到已有的养鸡出售答案，而不是让玩家停在一个孤立的讨论区首页。
sources.risk: The official answer in the animal record also lacks a retained direct URL. Recheck the current build before treating the sale status as unchanged.
sources.riskZh: 动物记录里的官方答复同样没有保留原帖直链；把出售状态当作仍未变化前，应该重新核对当前版本。
sources.sourceLabel: Open player question + existing animal record
sources.sourceLabelZh: 待验证玩家问题 + 现有动物记录

sources.title: Missing seed
sources.summary: A current discussion is asking why a seed is unavailable or missing. It is a lead for checking season, shop schedule, inventory and the exact seed name, not proof of a universal bug.
sources.summaryZh: 当前讨论区有人询问种子不可用或消失的原因。它适合作为选题线索，下一步要核对季节、商店营业、背包和种子名称，不能直接当成通用 bug。
sources.why: A useful report needs the missing seed name, season, shop and a screenshot of the inventory or purchase screen.
sources.whyZh: 要把它变成可解决的问题，需要补充种子名称、季节、商店状态，以及背包或购买界面截图。
sources.risk: A missing seed may be seasonal, shop-related or inventory-related; this card does not establish a bug.
sources.riskZh: 种子不见可能与季节、商店或背包有关；这张卡不能证明存在通用 bug。

sources.title: Where are coal and zirconite?
sources.summary: The current discussion list includes a player asking for coal and zirconite locations. The site's materials record already has a current purchase route for Zirconite; the unresolved part is the coal route, which still needs a readable screenshot or independent report.
sources.summaryZh: 当前讨论列表里有人询问煤和锆矿的位置。本站材料记录已经有锆矿的当前购买路线；仍未解决的是煤的获取路线，需要清晰截图或独立报告。
sources.why: It prevents the known Zirconite answer from being buried inside a broader unresolved question, while keeping the coal gap visible for future map work.
sources.whyZh: 它不会让已知的锆矿答案被一个更大的开放问题掩盖，同时保留煤路线这个真正需要补证的缺口。
sources.risk: Do not use an old map pin for coal. The Zirconite purchase route is separate from any wild-ore or coal route.
sources.riskZh: 不要把旧地图图钉当作煤的当前路线；锆矿购买路线与野外矿石或煤的路线是两件事。

sources.title: What happens after Gigi's egg quest?
sources.titleZh: Gigi 的鸡蛋任务之后还有什么？
sources.summary: Players are still asking about the story after the egg route. Current reports suggest it may be the present content endpoint, but the question remains useful because a new patch could change that endpoint.
sources.summaryZh: 玩家仍在询问鸡蛋任务线之后的剧情。当前报告倾向于认为这是现阶段内容终点，但新补丁可能改变这个终点，所以问题仍值得跟踪。
sources.why: The guide labels the current endpoint instead of inventing a hidden trigger, and points players to the source discussion when they have newer evidence.
sources.whyZh: 指南会标出当前内容终点，不编造隐藏触发条件；如果玩家发现新线索，可以回到原讨论或提交证据。
sources.risk: The current endpoint may change with a patch; do not infer a hidden quest trigger from this question alone.
sources.riskZh: 当前终点可能随补丁变化；不要只凭这个问题推断存在隐藏任务触发条件。

sources.title: A review reports reaching the current content boundary
sources.titleZh: 一条评测称已经走到当前内容边界
sources.summary: A recent Steam review describes feeling that the playable quest content runs out after roughly two or three quests. That is a report about one player's run, not evidence that the game contains only that many quests.
sources.summaryZh: 一条近期 Steam 评测提到，玩家感觉可玩的任务内容在大约两三个任务后就暂时结束。这只是一次游玩经历的报告，不能证明游戏总共只有这么多任务。
sources.why: It gives the quest database a current question to check: which quests are documented, which are triggered or optional, and where the current-build evidence stops.
sources.whyZh: 它给任务数据库提出了一个当前问题：哪些任务已有记录，哪些可能是触发式或可选任务，以及当前版本证据到哪里为止。
sources.risk: Do not turn this review into a total quest count, a roadmap claim or a statement that the game is finished. Verify quest names, triggers and build context independently.
sources.riskZh: 不要把这条评测写成任务总数、官方路线图或“游戏已经结束”的结论。任务名称、触发条件和版本背景都需要独立核对。

sources.title: A review reports chickens stuck around a door
sources.titleZh: 一条评测报告了鸡在门附近卡住
sources.summary: One recent Steam review says several chickens and a rooster became stuck around a door, leaving a chick outside and unable to be picked up. The review does not state the build or establish a reproducible cause.
sources.summaryZh: 一条近期 Steam 评测称，几只鸡和一只公鸡在门附近卡住，导致一只小鸡被留在外面且无法抱起。评测没有说明版本，也不能证明可稳定复现的原因。
sources.why: It adds a current animal-care lead to the existing post-hotfix checklist without turning one review into a universal bug claim.
sources.whyZh: 它把当前动物照料线索接入热修复后的排查清单，同时不把单条评测扩大成通用 Bug 结论。
sources.risk: This is one report with no build, save, door state or reproduction steps. Check for a current-build reproduction before changing the animal answer.
sources.riskZh: 这是一条没有版本、存档、门的状态或复现步骤的单独报告。修改动物答案前，必须先做当前版本复现。

sources.title: Victor is not at Town Hall
sources.summary: A current discussion asks where to find Victor after the electricity objective points the player toward Town Hall. The post does not establish that Victor should always be there, so the next check is the exact objective text, current build and map-app route.
sources.summaryZh: 当前讨论有人询问：电力目标把玩家指向市政厅后，为什么找不到 Victor。帖子不能证明 Victor 一定会一直在市政厅，下一步要核对任务原文、当前版本和手机地图路线。
sources.why: It connects a live NPC-location question to the existing Victor and electricity answers without inventing a spawn schedule or a missing quest step.
sources.whyZh: 它把当前 NPC 地点问题接到已有 Victor 和电力答案，同时不编造出现时间表或缺失任务步骤。
sources.risk: The thread has no retained official resolution in this scan. Do not state a fixed Victor location until the objective and build are checked.
sources.riskZh: 本轮扫描没有保留到官方解决答复。核对任务原文和版本前，不要把 Victor 的位置写成固定事实。

sources.title: No door plan at the workbench
sources.summary: A current building question asks why a door plan is missing from the workbench. It may be a blueprint, progression or placement question, but the thread title alone cannot distinguish those cases.
sources.summaryZh: 当前建造问题在询问：为什么工作台里没有门的蓝图。它可能是蓝图、推进条件或放置问题，但仅凭标题无法区分。
sources.why: It gives the building guide a concrete follow-up and tells players which evidence to include: workbench category, current build, unlocked blueprints and a screenshot.
sources.whyZh: 它给建造指南一个具体跟进点，并告诉玩家应补充：工作台分类、当前版本、已解锁蓝图和截图。
sources.risk: No current official answer was found in this scan. Do not infer a door recipe or unlock condition from older Alpha material.
sources.riskZh: 本轮扫描没有找到当前官方答复。不要从旧 Alpha 资料推断门的配方或解锁条件。

sources.title: Use the real Steam hub to ask and answer
sources.titleZh: 去 Steam 社区发帖和回答
sources.summary: Steam is the live discussion layer: players can post questions, attach screenshots and reply in their own accounts. Use this page to find active threads, evidence labels and useful follow-up routes.
sources.summaryZh: Steam 是实时讨论场所：玩家可以用自己的账号发帖、上传截图和回复。本页整理活跃讨论、证据标签与后续路线，方便继续查找和参与。
sources.why: The fastest way to get a new answer is still to ask where the active players and moderators already are.
sources.whyZh: 想最快得到新答案，仍然应该去活跃玩家和版主所在的讨论区提问。
sources.risk: The Steam hub is a live conversation, not a verified answer source; check the build and author before repeating a claim.
sources.riskZh: Steam 讨论区是实时对话，不等于已验证答案；转述观点前要核对版本和作者。

sources.title: No stone available
sources.summary: A current discussion asks where stone is available. The title alone does not establish a mine, tool, respawn or purchase route, so the next check is the current build and a screenshot of the player's area.
sources.summaryZh: 当前讨论有人询问哪里能找到石头。标题本身不能证明存在矿洞、工具、刷新或购买路线，下一步应核对当前版本和玩家所在区域截图。
sources.why: It connects a high-intent materials question to the existing Stone record without inventing a new supply method.
sources.whyZh: 它把高意图材料问题接到现有石头条目，同时不编造新的获取方法。
sources.risk: No current official resolution was retained in this scan. Do not turn the question into a mine location or a repeatable route.
sources.riskZh: 本轮没有保留到当前官方解决答复。不要把问题写成矿洞位置或稳定获取路线。

sources.title: Where to find coal and Zerkonite
sources.summary: A current discussion asks where to find coal and Zerkonite. The question does not establish that either material has a mine route in the current build; the existing purchase answer for Zerkonite remains separate from the unresolved coal question.
sources.summaryZh: 当前讨论有人询问煤和锆矿在哪里找。问题不能证明当前版本存在矿洞路线；现有锆矿购买答案与尚未解决的煤问题继续分开。
sources.why: It gives the materials database a concrete follow-up while preserving the known Zerkonite purchase route and the unresolved boundary around coal.
sources.whyZh: 它给材料数据库一个具体跟进点，同时保留已知的锆矿购买路线，并明确煤的证据缺口。
sources.risk: Do not infer a mine, drop source or price from the discussion title. Verify the material name, build and an in-game screenshot before changing the database.
sources.riskZh: 不要仅凭讨论标题推断矿洞、掉落来源或价格。修改数据库前应核对材料名称、版本和游戏内截图。
